speaker: Daniel
text: Although China is a latecomer in lunar exploration, its program has made many achievements in a few expeditions. The country verified its lunar probe technologies in 2007 with the successful launch of Chang'e-1, the first spacecraft stemming from the program. In 2013 Chang'e-3 accomplished China's first soft-landing on the moon, which was the first man-made craft to achieve this goal in nearly four decades.
